snippet.title: Reel Talk // Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4290530/Reel_Talk/

Cast your line, catch some fish, and make real connections. REEL TALK is a cozy multiplayer fishing game where you hang out, customize your character with pride, and chat with friends old and new. No pressure, no competition-just good vibes by the water.

👥 Players: LAN + Online Co-op
🛠️ Developer: Lost Rabbit Digital
📚 Publisher: Lost Rabbit Digital
📅 Release Date: Sep 24, 2026 
🎯 Genre: Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation


AI Generated Content Disclosure

Music, Sound Effects
